name: AxleBeacon
tagline: Telematics built for the person who also drives the truck
positioning: AxleBeacon gives small fleet owner-operators live tracking, IFTA fuel tax, and maintenance alerts in one dashboard — without the enterprise price tag.

hero.h1: Run your whole fleet from the cab, not a back office
hero.sub: AxleBeacon puts live vehicle tracking, automated IFTA fuel tax, and maintenance reminders in one place — so you can dispatch, log miles, and stay compliant without hiring a fleet manager.

features.title: See every truck in real time
features.description: Live GPS with breadcrumb history and geofence alerts. Know exactly where your rigs are when a customer calls asking for an ETA.

features.title: IFTA reports that file themselves
features.description: AxleBeacon tracks miles per jurisdiction from your GPS data and drops a quarter-ready IFTA summary into your inbox. No more shoebox of fuel receipts.

features.title: Maintenance before it's a breakdown
features.description: Odometer-based reminders for oil changes, DOT inspections, and tire rotations. Log DVIRs from the driver app in under a minute.

features.title: HOS and ELD, handled
features.description: FMCSA-registered ELD logs hours of service automatically and flags violations before they turn into a roadside citation.

features.title: Coach safer driving
features.description: Weekly safety scores for hard braking, speeding, and idle time — the numbers that actually move your insurance premium.

features.title: Fuel spend you can defend
features.description: Match fuel-card charges to trips and idle time so you catch skimming and pointless mileage before it eats your margin.

testimonials.quote: I used to spend a full Sunday every quarter reconciling fuel receipts for IFTA. AxleBeacon has it ready before I even sit down. That's my weekend back.
testimonials.name: Marcus Elder

testimonials.quote: We run nine reefers and I'm still the dispatcher. The geofence alerts mean I stop babysitting the map and customers stop calling me for ETAs.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghavan

testimonials.quote: The maintenance reminders caught a brake issue two weeks before our DOT inspection. That one alert paid for the whole year of AxleBeacon.
testimonials.name: Dwayne Foster

pricing.blurb: For one truck and the person driving it.
For 3–25 trucks, billed per active vehicle.
For fleets over 25 trucks with API needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: AxleBeacon is telematics for small fleets that don't have a back office — live tracking, IFTA, and compliance in one honest dashboard.
